functions.funcDef: Command the primary control surfaces in response to pilot and autopilot inputs to control the aircraft flight path (§5.6/§5.7).
functions.subName: Provide primary flight control via channel A
functions.subDef: FCA commands its half of each surface pair (left/right elevator, aileron, upper rudder segment) from the primary sensor set on EL1 (§5.6.2). Independent of channel B: dissimilar processor, dissimilar software, separate air-data source, separate power (§5.6.5 'shares no power, sensing or processing element with channel B').

functions.funcDef: Command the primary control surfaces in response to pilot and autopilot inputs to control the aircraft flight path (§5.6/§5.7).
functions.subName: Provide primary flight control via channel B
functions.subDef: FCB commands the other half of each surface pair (elevator inboard, opposite aileron, lower rudder segment) from the standby sensor set on EL2 (§5.7.2). Dissimilar counterpart to channel A; independent air-data source (§5.7.3 'the two channels do not fail together on a common air-data source').

functions.funcDef: Command the primary control surfaces in response to pilot and autopilot inputs to control the aircraft flight path (§5.6/§5.7).
functions.subDef: Residual mechanical path to pitch trim and the lower rudder segment, retained when both channels are gone (§5.6.3 'it is what remains when both channels are gone'). Not a selectable mode; independent of both fly-by-wire channels.

functions.funcDef: Convert propulsion-bus electrical energy into shaft power at the propellers and modulate it to thrust command (§5.1/§5.2).
functions.subDef: PRL converts propulsion-bus HV DC to shaft power at the left propeller, modulated to FCA/FCB thrust command (§5.1.1). Independent of the right unit by installation — separate nacelle, HV run A, channel-1 control power (§5.1.4); pair-level sizing case is single-unit sector continuation (§5.1.3).

functions.funcDef: Convert propulsion-bus electrical energy into shaft power at the propellers and modulate it to thrust command (§5.1/§5.2).
functions.subDef: PRR converts propulsion-bus HV DC to shaft power at the right propeller, modulated to thrust command (§5.2.1). Identical to PRL by part number; differs only in installation — HV run B, channel 2, opposite nacelle (§5.2.2 'two units of identical design are not two independent units in every respect').

functions.funcDef: Convert propulsion-bus electrical energy into shaft power at the propellers and modulate it to thrust command (§5.1/§5.2).
functions.subDef: Electrical feather on command, independent of the propulsion bus, feathering a windmilling propeller so the remaining unit's rating suffices (§5.1.2, §5.1.3). Commanded manually or automatically on locked-rotor detection (§5.1.6).

functions.funcDef: Present attitude, air data, powertrain state and prioritised warnings to the crew, and supply sensed data to the flight-control channels (§5.10/§5.11).
functions.subName: Provide primary flight and powertrain display
functions.subDef: DPP presents attitude, air data, powertrain state and hosts the crew alerting function prioritising discretes/data from every §2.2 system; supplies air+inertial data to FCA (§5.10.1/§5.10.2). On EL1 and the primary sensor set.

functions.funcDef: Present attitude, air data, powertrain state and prioritised warnings to the crew, and supply sensed data to the flight-control channels (§5.10/§5.11).
functions.subName: Provide standby attitude and air-data indication
functions.subDef: DPS presents attitude and air data on a source and supply independent of DPP, and supplies sensed data to FCB (§5.11.1). Independent across four things at once — sensor, probe, electrical channel and dedicated battery (§5.11.3).

functions.funcName: Control aircraft on the ground and water
functions.funcDef: Extend/retract/indicate the landing gear and provide directional control on the water (§5.14/§5.13).
functions.subName: Extend, retract and indicate landing gear
functions.subDef: LDG electro-mechanically actuates a tricycle gear, sensed by two dissimilar means per unit compared against selected landing surface (§5.14.1/§5.14.2). Power split across both channels; mechanical free-fall extension below all of it (§5.14.3).

functions.funcName: Control aircraft on the ground and water
functions.funcDef: Extend/retract/indicate the landing gear and provide directional control on the water (§5.14/§5.13).
functions.subDef: Retractable water rudder at the sternpost, steered from the rudder pedals via a mechanical path independent of the air-rudder run, retraction hardwire-interlocked to gear-down (§5.13.1/§5.13.2). Simplex; reverts to differential thrust on actuator failure (§5.13.3).

functions.funcName: Protect against fire and thermal events
functions.funcDef: Detect fire, overheat and thermal-runaway in the designated fire zones and cabin, contain or isolate, and give the crew the means to discharge (§5.15).
functions.subDef: Dual-loop detection in the store bay, generator compartment and each nacelle plus module-level thermal sensing in the store bay, and photoelectric cabin/baggage smoke detection (§5.15.2). Loops on separate channels/routes (§5.15.5).

functions.funcName: Protect against fire and thermal events
functions.funcDef: Detect fire, overheat and thermal-runaway in the designated fire zones and cabin, contain or isolate, and give the crew the means to discharge (§5.15).
functions.subName: Contain, isolate and suppress fire and thermal events
functions.subDef: Containment (store-bay enclosure + overboard vent), isolation (fuel shutoff, propulsion-bus contactor open, feather) and extinguishant discharge (generator bottle only) (§5.15.2/§5.15.4). Store bay has no extinguishant by design.

functions.funcDef: Maintain cabin pressure, temperature and ventilation throughout the mission and clear the windscreen (§5.16).
functions.subDef: Bleed-fed air-cycle pack conditions cabin air, pressure controlled by a single outflow valve with an independent positive-pressure relief valve (§5.16.2). Single pack; no pressurisation on the electrical reversion path (§5.16.3).

functions.funcDef: Maintain cabin pressure, temperature and ventilation throughout the mission and clear the windscreen (§5.16).
functions.subDef: Air-cycle pack for conditioning, with an electrical recirculation fan and heater on channel 2 providing ventilation and heating (unpressurised) when the generator is shut down (§5.16.2/§5.16.3).

functions.funcDef: Maintain cabin pressure, temperature and ventilation throughout the mission and clear the windscreen (§5.16).
functions.subDef: Bleed-fed windscreen anti-fog with an electric backup element (§5.16.2 'Windscreen anti-fog is bleed-fed with an electric backup element').
