assumptions.text: The hull's watertight integrity and structural load path (HUF/HUA structure) are structural properties substantiated by structural analysis and PRA, not functional-FHA items; only the water-rudder directional-control behaviour of HUA is authored as a function.
assumptions.rationale: The SDD calls HUF/HUA structural ('There is nothing to reconfigure — this is structure'), and the modeling rule excludes structural integrity from the functional FHA.
assumptions.ifWrong: If flotation/watertight integrity is to be assessed functionally (plausible given the special condition on the hull as a flight function), a 'Maintain hull watertight integrity / flotation' aircraft function would be added.
assumptions.usedFor: Exclusion of HUF/HUA structural behaviour from the function list; inclusion of water directional control only.

citations.quote: There is nothing to reconfigure — this is structure, and its behaviour is set at build

assumptions.text: The FCA/FCB channels fail independently at the granularity modeled (one sub-function per channel), based on the SDD's dissimilarity and separation narrative.
assumptions.rationale: The decomposition splits primary flight control into two channel sub-functions on the SDD's claim of no shared power/sensing/processing; if that independence is not sustained the split granularity would change.
assumptions.ifWrong: If a common element defeats channel independence, the two channel sub-functions collapse toward a single failure path and the AFHA severity/architecture argument changes.
assumptions.usedFor: add_function 'Provide primary flight control via channel A' and '...via channel B'.

assumptions.text: Complete loss of one flight-control channel is modelled with two partials (within-MAC and outside-MAC degraded modes) per the two-partial TL style.
assumptions.rationale: The SDD gives redundancy and MAC-sizing intent but no failure-effect classification, so the TL-decomposition style had to be chosen.
assumptions.ifWrong: If the single-partial (minimum-acceptable-configuration) style is preferred, the two SF-001/SF-002 partial entries collapse to one degraded-mode entry each.

citations.quote: the surfaces are sized so that one half of each pair is sufficient

assumptions.text: The channel-A and channel-B erroneous/drift conditions can develop slowly enough to stay within the monitored cross-compare band before annunciation, justifying a crew-Unaware row.
assumptions.rationale: The SDD states cross-compare monitoring and annunciation but gives no detection threshold or latency, so the undetected sub-condition cannot be dismissed.
assumptions.ifWrong: If cross-compare detects all erroneous/drift conditions, the SF-001/SF-002 Unaware rows are removed and those malfunctions live only on the Aware rows.
assumptions.usedFor: SF-001 Unaware row, SF-002 Unaware row

citations.quote: they do not exchange state except through a monitored cross-compare of surface position

assumptions.text: Loss of the mechanical reversion path is not annunciated in normal operation and is therefore a latent (crew-Unaware) condition.
assumptions.rationale: The SDD describes reversion as a non-selectable last-resort path with no stated health monitoring, so its loss is assumed undetected.
assumptions.ifWrong: If reversion integrity is monitored and annunciated, the SF-003 row becomes crew-Aware.

citations.quote: it is not a selectable mode — it is what remains when both channels are gone

assumptions.text: An undetected erroneous thrust command below annunciation thresholds is possible on each propulsion unit, warranting a crew-Unaware malfunction row.
assumptions.rationale: The SDD lists thrust/torque/temperature indication but no detection threshold for an erroneous command, so the undetected case cannot be grounded or dismissed.
assumptions.ifWrong: If thrust monitoring detects all erroneous commands, the SF-004/SF-005 Unaware rows are removed.
assumptions.usedFor: SF-004 Unaware row, SF-005 Unaware row

assumptions.text: SF-006 feather-complete discrete makes the actively-commanded feather-failure case crew-aware, so only the undetected loss of the feather path carries a separate Unaware row.
assumptions.rationale: The SDD states a feather-complete discrete exists but does not state a crew alert for a failed-to-feather condition, forcing a judgement on which variant is detectable.
assumptions.ifWrong: If no crew cue exists for a failed feather, the SF-006 total-loss condition moves entirely to the Unaware row and its downstream classification changes.

citations.quote: a feather-complete discrete to the flight control channels.

assumptions.text: The continuous primary/standby cross-compare annunciates disagreement but does not vote, so a common-mode erroneous output consistent across both sources could develop undetected.
assumptions.rationale: The SDD describes annunciate-not-resolve cross-comparison, leaving open whether an erroneous-but-agreeing state is detectable, which the Unaware rows for SF-007 and SF-008 depend on.
assumptions.ifWrong: If the design detects agreeing-but-wrong data, the SF-007/SF-008 Unaware malfunction rows are removed.
assumptions.usedFor: SF-007 Unaware row, SF-008 Unaware row

citations.quote: a disagreement is annunciated rather than resolved automatically — the design does not vote two sources.

assumptions.text: Gear position uses two dissimilar sensors compared against the selected surface, so a routine wrong-configuration indication is crew-aware and only a coincident dual-sensor error is undetectable.
assumptions.rationale: The SDD states a comparison-based indication but not the behaviour when both sensor means agree wrongly, which the SF-009 Unaware row leans on.
assumptions.ifWrong: If dual-sensor common failure is precluded, the SF-009 Unaware row is removed.

citations.quote: gear position is sensed by two dissimilar means per unit

assumptions.text: Water directional control is a water-taxi-phase function with differential-thrust reversion, so its conditions are scoped to on-water operation.
assumptions.rationale: The SDD ties the water rudder to water taxi with a differential-thrust fallback but the phase applicability is not otherwise stated in the function list.
assumptions.ifWrong: If the function is credited outside water taxi, the SF-010 conditions and their exposure basis change.

citations.quote: directional control on the water reverts to differential thrust.

assumptions.text: A single detection-loop failure annunciates as a loop fault rather than a fire warning, so partial loss of SF-011 is crew-aware.
assumptions.rationale: The SDD states the loop-fault behaviour but the FHA effects/detection thresholds do not yet exist to confirm crew visibility of every partial case.
assumptions.ifWrong: The SF-011 partial-loss condition would move to the crew-Unaware row and change its detection posture.

assumptions.rationale: Dual-loop AND logic means a below-threshold or single-loop event may not warn; no FHA detection means yet substantiates full crew awareness.
assumptions.ifWrong: The SF-011 Unaware row would be dismissed and the undetected condition dropped.

assumptions.rationale: House-style ruling requires awareness-dismissal reasoning to be filed here, not in the matrix cell; no FHA detection means exists to test this yet.
assumptions.ifWrong: An undetected anti-fog degradation would need its own crew-Unaware row.

assumptions.text: SF-001 as written ('Provide primary flight control via channel A') is a single redundant channel of the aircraft-level 'Control aircraft trajectory' function, not an aircraft function in its own right.
assumptions.rationale: The project's acFunctions list SF-001 under 'of: Control aircraft trajectory' and the SDD describes FCA as one of two channels; the tasked conditions are channel-scoped, forcing a decision on whether they classify at aircraft or system level.

assumptions.text: Deriving an aircraft-level severity for any single channel-A condition would require asserting channel-B transfer and mechanical-reversion availability as independent mitigations.
assumptions.rationale: The SF-001 function definition names only channel A; whether a channel-A failure has an aircraft effect depends entirely on the untasked surviving-path behaviour, which the function definition does not establish.
assumptions.ifWrong: If channel B / reversion cannot be assumed independent or available, single-channel conditions could rise toward Hazardous/Catastrophic; if they are firmly established, several could resolve to Minor/No Safety Effect — either way severity changes from EMPTY.

assumptions.text: The governing certification basis and severity-to-probability objectives are Part 23 Class III (AC 23.1309-1E), per the SDD, not the Part 25 basis in project setup.
assumptions.rationale: The project state declares Part 25 while the uploaded SDD explicitly declares Part 23 Class III; the two cannot both govern and the numeric objective attached to each severity class depends on which one does.
assumptions.ifWrong: If Part 25 governs, the qualitative classes stand but the quantitative safety objective under each class (and downstream allocation) changes; no severity letter changes on these five rows.

assumptions.text: Either flight-control channel alone, plus the mechanical reversion path, is sufficient to control the aircraft, so a single-channel loss/malfunction does not by itself cause loss of control.
assumptions.rationale: Severity of these single-channel conditions is bounded by the surviving channel; without confirming the sufficiency claim the classifications would be understated.
assumptions.ifWrong: If a single channel is not sufficient in some phase, SF-002-M/M2 could rise from Major toward Hazardous and the undetected cases toward Catastrophic.

assumptions.rationale: The Major classification of the detected malfunction cases relies on the monitor's coverage of those specific modes and on the transfer arresting the excursion before margins are lost; the SDD asserts the monitor exists but not its coverage or timing.
assumptions.ifWrong: If the cross-compare does not cover these modes or transfer is too slow, SF-002-M and SF-002-M2 rise toward Hazardous.
